name: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie face up on a flat bench with feet planted and your upper back resting firmly on the pad.
Cup the underside of one dumbbell end with both palms and hold it straight above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows as you lower the dumbbell back in an arc behind your head.
Pull the dumbbell smoothly along the same arc until it returns above your chest.
tips: End the backward reach before your lower back arches off the bench.
Keep your elbows slightly bent at a fixed angle instead of turning the movement into a triceps extension.
